text:
Sam - AE: Heads up — Nimbus Analytics requesting 3-month POC with a 40% introductory discount and a 12mo paid commit if POC succeeds. They also want billing start deferred until GA. Can we route as a temporary promo + commit exception?
Rachel - RevOps: @Sam we need company legal name + projected ARR if commit converts. Standard routing: deal desk review -> RevOps pricing ticket -> Finance sign-off for deferred billing.
Sam - AE: Nimbus Analytics, ARR estimate $250k on commit. POC run-rate: $18k/mo for 3 months.
Alex - Sales Eng: Add POC SLOs to SOW so we can size Dedicated vs hosted: concurrent sessions, tokens/day, latency targets.
Jess - Legal: Deferred billing requires a short addendum. I can draft an addendum that defines billing trigger and discount duration. Need to confirm data residency for POC.
Naveen - Finance: Deferred billing ok with signed 12mo commitment and a clear billing start trigger. Also need clarity whether discount applies only to first 12 months or entire commitment.
Sam - AE: They want discount only for the first 12 months.
Rachel - RevOps: Process: file revops ticket with SKU, discount %, effective dates, attach SOW + addendum, paste commit clause and billing trigger. Tag @dealdesk in ticket. Use template pricing-exception-v2.
Alex - Sales Eng: POC sizing snippet for SOW:
```
POC scope: up to 30 concurrent sessions, ~2M tokens/day, latency target 200ms p50. If exceeded, parties to evaluate Dedicated sizing and cost.
```
Sam - AE: @Jess can you draft the addendum today? Need ticket in before EOD to make Q booking.
Jess - Legal: I can get a draft by 3pm PT. Proposed clause: "introductory discount applies to first 12 months of paid service upon billing start; billing start = date customer accepts go-live checklist or 30 days after SOW execution, whichever occurs first." Thoughts?
Naveen - Finance: Works for Finance. Add explicit language: credits non-refundable and overages billed at list.
dealbot: RevOps ticket created: D-4321 by Sam - AE (status: draft)
Sam - AE: Filed D-4321 and will attach Jess's addendum when ready.
Rachel - RevOps: Adding to today's deal desk agenda. If approved, RevOps will issue a special pricing approval doc with promo code and expiry. Expect decision by 5pm PT. :thumbsup: 
Alex - Sales Eng: Also include allowed model variants under promo (e.g., latency-optimized small) to prevent accidental cost spikes.
Jess - Legal: Added model restriction paragraph. Posting final addendum to ticket in ~20m.
Naveen - Finance: If deal desk approves, Finance will sign-off on deferred billing terms; note ARR may not be recognized until billing starts.
Rachel - RevOps: Approved by deal desk @16:50 PT. Conditions: discount capped to first 12 months, promo expires in 90 days, SOW addendum signed, billing trigger = "Production go-live" in SOW. Tagging @Naveen for final finance sign-off.
Naveen - Finance: Finance signs off. Ensure quote shows deferred billing start and revenue ops are notified.
Sam - AE: Sending final quote and SOW to Nimbus. Thanks team. :rocket:
